story.heading: Our Story
story.body:
It all begins with a sprout.

Seguras Farm Shop was born from a simple idea: instead of relying on a single farm, build a network of producers across different regions of Costa Rica, each an expert in what their land does best. High-altitude coffee from Tarrazú, fresh catch from the Pacific, vegetables from the volcanic foothills, honey from the northern zone.

At Arbórea we take that curated selection of partner farms straight to your table the same day. Every dish carries the name of the region that grew it, every sprout tells a story of patience, and every bite is our way of saying thank you to the Costa Rican land that feeds us.

Farm-to-table cooking. Ingredients with a region's first and last name. An experience that truly tastes of Costa Rica.

goodToKnow.title: Our collective of curated jungle residences are located in a pristine mountain environment, and part of the magic of staying here comes with a few things worth keeping in mind to ensure a comfortable experience.

meshDoors.title: Mesh Doors and Windows
meshDoors.description: Our collective of curated jungle residences are equipped with mesh screens on doors and windows to keep insects out. We kindly ask that you keep them closed at all times, especially in the evenings, to ensure a comfortable and bug-free stay.

powerOutages.title: Power Outages
powerOutages.description: Due to our remote mountain location, occasional brief power outages may occur. We recommend keeping your phone charged and having a flashlight handy, both of which are available at the casa.

transportation.title: Transportation
transportation.description: A 4x4 vehicle with 4-wheel traction is required to access the casas and surrounding areas safely. Arborea can arrange transportation for you — but if you prefer to rent your own vehicle, make sure it has full 4-wheel drive engaged, not just all-wheel drive.

foodStorage.title: Food Storage
foodStorage.description: We ask that all food be stored in the refrigerator or in sealed containers when not in use. Leaving food out in the kitchen or common areas can attract wildlife, which is a natural part of our mountain ecosystem but best admired from a distance.

nighttimeLighting.title: Nighttime Lighting
nighttimeLighting.description: We provide exterior lighting along pathways for your safety. Please keep in mind that lights left on unnecessarily at night tend to attract insects, so we suggest turning off any lights in rooms or terraces that are not in use, and keeping doors and windows closed.
